_comment: Instruments the two-peer GTNet application suite exchanges, addressed by natural key because the ids differ
between grafioschtrader_t and grafioschtrader_t1. Both peers migrate from db/migration/test, so these rows exist
on both sides with their four gt_net_* exchange flags already set to 1; the suite only asserts against them and
Consumed by GTNetAppLastpriceExchangeTest, GTNetAppHistoryquoteExchangeTest, GTNetAppSecurityLookupTest and
GTNetAppSupplierDetailTest. The e2e tag is 'd' throughout: every row is already part of the Flyway test data.
maxLimitProbeCount is the instrument count a request uses to provoke the *_MAX_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_S answer; it must
stay above the maxLimit the peer bootstrap writes into gt_net_entity (250).
